body: The approximation task is scalar unconditional survival, not survivor-state reconstruction, relative rare-event error, full adaptive transcript laws or lifetime moments. The finite model has finite mean lifetime while the source has infinite mean. Selfadjointness and common order are substantive physical premises; finite lifetime data alone do not acquire them. Current spectral/weak-Poincare antecedents are credited; novelty,device and advantage claims are separate. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions.
